get.description: Returns the authenticated user's RhHistories ordered by `created_at` descending. The list endpoint uses a slim serializer; fetch details via the page endpoints.

404.description: No RhProfile for the resource owner.

get.summary: List the resource owner's rent histories

post.description: Creates a new RhHistory tied to the authenticated user's RhProfile. Requires a valid OAuth2 access token in the `Authorization: Bearer` header.

404.description: No RhProfile for the resource owner.

post.summary: Create a new RhHistory for the resource owner

get.description: Returns `apartment` and `address` stored on the RhHistory after combine-pages (from scanned rent history pages). Used to bootstrap address confirmation in the rent-history app.

parameters.description: UUID of the RhHistory whose address fields should be returned.
parameters.name: history_id

get.summary: Get scan-extracted address for a RhHistory

get.description: Returns RhPage records with keep=True for this history (pages used in analysis after combine-pages). Sorted by start_year ascending. Each item includes start_year, end_year, and s3_key.

parameters.description: UUID of the RhHistory whose analysis pages should be returned.
parameters.name: history_id

get.summary: List analysis RhPages for a given RhHistory

post.description: Merges all pages for the given history (deduplicated by start_year/end_year, document-ordered), validates a contiguous reg_year sequence, applies pipeline transforms, sets is_421a_rh / is_j51_rh, and stores the result on data_initial. Does not return the merged table.

Updates address, apartment, bbl, and bin on an existing RhHistory, queries NYCDB for building unit counts and active program flags, sets last_step_reached to ADDRESS_CONFIRMATION, and returns the resolved values.

503.description: NYCDB is not configured or unavailable.

post.summary: Confirm address and look up NYCDB building info

post.description: Deletes all RhPage records for the given RhHistory belonging to the authenticated user. Also performs best-effort cleanup of versioned S3 objects under `<profile_id>/<history_id>/` in `RH_SCAN_BUCKET`.
post.summary: Delete RhPage scan data for a given RhHistory

post.description: Lambda-callable endpoint to record a scanned page. Authenticates via the static `RH_API_TOKEN` bearer rather than OAuth, since it is invoked from server-side AWS Lambda. The history must belong to the given profile.

get.description: Compares S3 object count under `<profile_id>/<history_id>/` and `RhPage` row count to client `num_pages`. Each axis returns `count`, `expected`, and `relation` (`less`, `equal`, `more`). HTTP 200 `status`: `ready` (both equal, includes `pages`), `pending` (still processing), or `excess` (more than `num_pages` on either axis). HTTP 400 is query validation only. HTTP 503 when DB count exceeds S3 count (invariant violation) or storage is misconfigured.

parameters.description: UUID of the RhHistory to check.
parameters.name: history_id

parameters.description: Number of pages the client believes were scanned (minimum 1).
parameters.name: num_pages

200.description: Readiness check succeeded (ready, pending, or excess).

503.description: Storage misconfiguration, S3 failure, or DB count exceeds S3 count.

get.summary: Scan upload and extraction readiness for a RhHistory

get.description: Returns the report PDF bytes for the authenticated user's RhHistory. 404 when no report has been generated or the S3 object is missing.

parameters.description: UUID of the RhHistory whose report PDF should be downloaded.
parameters.name: history_id

404.description: RhProfile, RhHistory, or report PDF not found.

503.description: Storage not configured or read failed.

get.summary: Download the stored rent history report PDF

post.description: Renders HTML (and optional CSS) to PDF, uploads to S3 under `{profile_pk}/reports/{history_id}.pdf`, and updates RhHistory report metadata and `last_step_reached` to REPORT_GENERATION.

503.description: Storage not configured or write failed.

post.summary: Generate and store a rent history report PDF

post.description: Composite login step: upserts the RhProfile for the phone number and issues/sends an OTP via SMS. Returns `profile`, `created`, and `otp` delivery status (`sent` or `pending` with optional `message`). Phone numbers are normalized to E.164 (US).
post.summary: Start RH login (upsert profile and request OTP)

get.description: Returns the RhProfile of the authenticated user (the OAuth2 resource owner).

404.description: No RhProfile for the resource owner.

post.description: Validates a previously issued OTP against the supplied phone number and (if successful) issues an OAuth2 access token and refresh token tied to the provided OAuth Application (`client_id` / `client_secret`). The Application must be configured with the password grant type. The returned `refresh_token` can be exchanged at the standard OAuth2 token endpoint (`POST /o/token/` with `grant_type=refresh_token`) for a new access token.

400.description: Invalid input, expired OTP, wrong grant type, or unauthorized client.

404.description: No user found with this phone number.

429.description: Too many invalid attempts; request a new code.

post.summary: Exchange an OTP for OAuth tokens
